title: fix(server): reject non-loopback Host on write APIs (DNS-rebind guard)
why:
The /api/preferences + /api/translation-requests POST endpoints now
require a 127.0.0.1/localhost Host header, blocking a remote page from
rebinding a hostname to loopback and writing .lore/.state. Writes were
already confined to .state, but this closes the request-forgery vector.

title: fix(config): parseConfigLanguage tolerates comment + CRLF on language: line
why:
v0.5.0's block regex required `language:` to end in whitespace+newline, so
a trailing comment (init-generated configs have one) or CRLF line endings
(Windows checkouts) silently fell back to default=en — disabling bilingual
on real configs. Allow a trailing comment + `\r`, and make the block-body
match CRLF-safe (JS `.` doesn't match `\r`, so CRLF dropped `available`).
Caught by dogfooding on threat-intel. (release 0.5.1)
